blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) on Tuesday, Sept. 29, announced the new fare rate for Epifanio delos Santos Avenue (Edsa) busway following the implementation of the fare hike. In an advisory, the LTFRB said the minimum fare for the EDSA busway is P18 for the first five kilometers, with an additional P2.98 for every succeeding kilometer in both southbound and northbound routes. Its previous fare was P15, with an additional P2.65 per kilometer.
